title: Let pain uncover what comfort was hiding
summary: Do not use the verse as atmosphere when it is asking to become examination. Do not let the day outrun this: let this stay with you: let pain reveal what comfort keeps covering.
takeaway: Keep this close: Let pain tell the truth before comfort edits it.
lifeApplication: At the next quiet pause, ask what the line revealed about your usual motive in this room today.

source.shortMeaning: Pain can uncover the dependence comfort often keeps hidden.
source.lifeApplication: When pain tightens the body, ask what surrender it is trying to uncover.
